【Sleep Summary & No Subscription Needed】 The Momcozy BM08 smart baby monitor tracks your baby’s sleep activities and provides sleep summaries without disturbing your little one. Access helpful sleep insights anytime without subscription, giving parents greater peace of mind. Suitable for new parents who care about their little one's sleep routine.
【True Cry Detection & Auto-Soothing White Noise】 Using AI cry detection technology, the BM08 smart baby monitor distinguishes your baby’s real cries from everyday background sounds, helping reduce unnecessary and false notifications. When crying is detected, the baby camera automatically plays gentle built-in white noise to comfort your little one, giving parents extra time to respond and soothe their baby.
【Electric Safety Zone & Real-Time Motion Detection】 The BM08 smart WiFi baby monitor allows parents to set a virtual safety zone around the crib or play area. If your baby moves outside the designated area, the baby camera sends an instant app notification for timely monitoring and response. AI motion detection tracks meaningful movement in real time while helping reduce unnecessary false notifications, giving parents greater peace of mind during naps and nighttime sleep.
【2K HD Vision & Contact-Free Baby Camera】The Momcozy BM08 smart WiFi baby monitor delivers clear 2K HD vision with up to 8x digital zoom, helping parents see their baby’s face, movements, and sleep space in detail clearly. 940nm invisible infrared night vision provides clear viewing in low light or darkness without harsh visible light. No wearable sensor, sock, clip, or device is required, offering comfortable, non-intrusive monitoring and greater peace of mind day and night.
【Private Protection for Baby & Peace of Mind for You】 Built-in 128-bit AES encryption, the BM08 baby monitor protects personal datas such as audio, video, picture or other information from unauthorized access. When baby monitoring is not needed, turn off the privacy button to instantly disable the camera and monitoring functions, adding an extra layer of privacy and peace of mind.
【NOTE: The BM08 smart contact-free baby camera is NOT A MEDICAL DEVICE and is NOT INTENDED FOR: ①Diagnose vital signs such as heart rate or oxygen levels, treat or cure any disease or any other conditions. ②Infants with known breathing difficulties. ③Monitoring for asthma, apnea, Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS), Sudden Unexpected Infant Death (SUID), or the overall health condition of infants. ④Replacement for adult supervision or safe sleep practices.】
